description: Single source of truth for all projects orchestrated from cortex. Only the project-router skill / scripts should mutate this file.

anya.description: Chromium MV3 sidebar extension wrapping @github/copilot-sdk via a Node Native Messaging bridge; spawns playwright-cli for in-tab browser automation.
anya.build: cd extension; npm install; npm run build; cd ../bridge; npm install; npx tsc -p .
anya.test: cd extension; npx tsc --noEmit; cd ../bridge; npx tsc --noEmit

engram.description: Indexes VS Code Copilot Chat history into a queryable SQLite DB shaped like the CLI session-store; runs incrementally via a Windows scheduled task. Ships an 'engram' Copilot skill.
